inconsistency_note: Page 4 paragraph 1 states 68% mortality after 24 h for 2014 An. coluzzii, while paragraph 2 states mortality increased from 67% (n = 43) to 98% (n = 53) in the PBO-treated group.
source_text: Mortality significantly increased in the PBO-treated group of 2014 An. coluzzii from 67% (n = 43) to 98% (n = 53, Fisher's exact test, P < 0.0001; Fig. 1a).
